clear autumn night at fifteen degrees in the bay
sun slipping early behind the golden gate hills

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Lane-switch through rolling fog banks at dawn, scooping dew drops into a jar before the sun burns them off.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one jar filled before sunrise feels complete
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, gaps between clear lanes shrink, dew evaporates faster
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor fog gradients over pale orange horizon

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap weld joints on a robot arm in rhythm while a garage fills with flashing investor silhouettes — each perfect chain completes one limb.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: finishing one fully articulated robot arm in under a minute
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tempo climbs, more joints per limb, missed beats spark and reset progress
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon blueprint wireframe on dark concrete garage floor

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous path linking phone shortcut icons to agent nodes before a sunrise shipment countdown hits zero.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one clean agent chain triggers a satisfying ship animation
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more nodes spawn mid-round, timer tightens, crossing paths short-circuit
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: flat iOS widget icons on midnight blue grid

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick defective code blocks off a conveyor belt while letting clean ones pass — ostrich mode if you ignore too many bugs.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick swipe to reject, tap to approve
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: survive one full conveyor cycle with zero escapes
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: belt speeds up, defect ratio climbs, approved blocks stack and block the lane
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: brutalist monospace terminal with amber scanlines
